description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for comment theming, including preprocessing functions for comments, blocks, and comment fields.

classes.name: CommentThemeHooks
classes.description: A class implementing hook functions for comment theming in Drupal, including preprocessing for comments, blocks, and comment fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: date formatter, renderer, entity type manager, theme settings provider.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Implements hook_theme() to define theme hooks for comments and comment fields.

methods.name: preprocessComment
methods.description: Prepares variables for comment templates, including author info, parent comment info, permalink, and status.

methods.name: preprocessBlock
methods.description: Preprocesses block templates, setting role attribute for comment provider blocks.

methods.name: preprocessField
methods.description: Prepares variables for comment field templates, including display mode, comment type, and associated comments and form.
